change_summary: Route each newly finalized Work Model source through one organization Mission, propagate the selected Workspace into Host reads and CLI subprocesses, and prevent duplicate readiness Questions or host-side whole-result reconstruction.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill and API reference make source-to-owner reconciliation the precedence branch and reserve ask_corvio for bounded work outside that lifecycle.

server_contract.note: The shared contract and MCP descriptions expose one-Mission source preparation, owner reconciliation, Skill evaluation and retry ownership.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.29 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.4.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI already documents the direct organize_files route; the Host now supplies CORVIO_WORKSPACE_ID process-locally so no persisted selection mutation is required.

help_center.note: Localized Help guidance distinguishes new-source Work Model reconciliation from bounded ask_corvio work.

package_setup.note: The package README mirrors the one-Mission decision order; the compact Claude hook remains compatible because the bundled Skill carries the detailed policy.

harness_and_mainline.note: The J1T3 failure is retained as trigger evidence; the mainline records route precedence, Workspace scoping and semantic acceptance boundaries.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Changed focused tests cover exact Host read arguments, process-local Workspace routing, route precedence, MCP descriptions, localized guidance and package parity; the unchanged CLI compatibility suite also passes, and live J1T3 remains the effect-level gate.
